properties.name: Masjid Shaikhain
properties.desc: Where the Prophet (ﷺ) donned armor before the Battle of Uhud.

properties.name: Masjid Mustarah
properties.desc: Where the Prophet (ﷺ) rested after the Battle of Uhud.

properties.name: The Holy Ka'bah
properties.desc: The House of Allah, the Qiblah for all Muslims.

properties.name: Masjid Quba
properties.desc: The first mosque built in Islamic history.

properties.name: Meezab ar-Rahmah (Golden Spout)
properties.desc: The golden spout on the northwest wall of the Kaaba overlooking Hijr Ismail.

properties.name: Bab al-Ka'bah (Golden Door)
properties.desc: The solid gold door of the Ka'bah elevated 2.13 meters above the ground.

properties.name: Kiswah Calligraphy Belt (Al-Hizam)
properties.desc: The gold-embroidered Quranic calligraphy belt encircling the upper Kiswah on all 4 walls.

properties.name: Maqam Ibrahim
properties.desc: The sacred stone bearing the footprint of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) housed in a crystal and gold kiosk.

properties.name: Hijr Ismail (Al-Hateem)
properties.desc: The semi-circular white marble wall embracing the northern portion of the Kaaba.

properties.name: Green Dome Base Drum
properties.desc: The cylindrical base drum of the Green Dome above the Sacred Chamber.

properties.name: The Green Dome (Al-Qubbah al-Khadra)
properties.desc: The iconic Green Dome of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).

properties.name: Green Dome Golden Crescent & Finial
properties.desc: The golden crescent atop the Green Dome.

properties.name: Al-Hajar al-Aswad (The Black Stone)
properties.desc: The sacred Black Stone mounted in its pure silver casing at Rukn al-Aswad, marking the beginning of Tawaf.

properties.name: Tawaf Start & End Line (Khat Bidayah wa Nihayah)
properties.arabic: خط بداية ونهاية الطواف المحاذي للحجر الأسود
properties.desc: The green marble line on the Mataf floor aligned directly with the Black Stone marking the start and finish of each circuit.
